summary: The Collection is broad and mostly solid on the dense account: lazy 60-row batches work, imports do not restamp unchanged rows, and the vault shells are consistent. The main problems are structural: one row renderer or toolbar reused where the context differs (Wishlist Purchased tab, empty and filtered vault states, the iPad toolbar that overflows leftwards over the count at 1180 px and the strip that hides Games at 820 px), per-module editors each re-implementing score, cover and progress grammar (Books' own progressText, a VN percent mode the UI cannot reach, a broken cover glyph only in editors), and cross-domain links that are not maintained (deleting a vault entry leaves the Wishlist link dangling with no undo; AniList-owned lists can be renamed locally and come back). UX friction comes from a full-grid re-render on +1 that moves the card to the top under the default sort, contradictory or dead-end copy (Find new without AniList, Steam signed out, 'no import API'), and the Shrine filtered reorder that drops other media's ranks (earlier run). No P0; one P1 (Games unreachable in the iPad portrait section strip), re-verified.

findings.title: Collection section strip hides the Games vault on iPad portrait (inner pill group scrolls invisibly)
findings.detail: On every Collection page at 820px the vault pill group (Overview, Anime, Books, Visual Novels, Games) is squeezed to 408px of its 484px and scrolls inside itself with its scrollbar hidden. Games is cut off at the right edge with no arrow or fade; the outer section scroller sees no overflow (sw 716 = cw 716) so its arrows never appear. A user on the iPad has no visible way to reach Games from the strip.
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/empty-mediasync-ipad.png (strip shows Overview..Visual Novels, no Games); eval: .k-seg sw=484 cw=408 x=88, Games item x=483 w=85; shell.subnav-scroller sw=716 cw=716
findings.fix: Give the section's pill group `flex: none` inside `.k-subnav` (css/components.css:80-82) so the overflow moves to the outer `k-subnav-scroller`, which already has arrows; or drop overflow-x:auto from `.k-seg` when it is a child of `.k-subnav`.
findings.rootCause: css/components.css:52 `.k-seg { max-inline-size:100%; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none }` makes the group's min-content 0, so as a flex child of `.k-subnav` (components.css:80) it shrinks and scrolls itself instead of overflowing the scroller mobile-shell.js:103-125 wraps around the subnav.

findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/empty-matrix-mac.png

findings.title: Mangaka is marked as the Anime page (strip lights Anime; phone header reads 'Anime')
findings.devices: all; most visible on iPhone where the page title says Anime
findings.detail: Mangaka is built from the Books vault ('Every author on your shelves', its Actions go to the Books vault) but the section strip highlights Anime as current, and the phone shell's section title above the page reads 'Anime ▾'. Current-location marking is wrong and confusing (you came from Books).

findings.title: Mangaka takes ~3 s to render on the dense account (reads and groups every book on each open)
findings.detail: Navigating Home → #/mangaka with 1,107 books took ~2.9 s until the DOM settled (Books vault 1.5 s, Anime 1.1 s, Overview 0.8 s). The page queries the whole Books module, groups by author and computes works/volumes/chapters per author in the sort comparator (worksOf/mkVols/mkChapters re-filter per comparison), every paint and on every search keystroke.
findings.evidence: eval timing: {'#/mangaka':2925ms,'#/books':1554,'#/anime':1074,'#/matrix':792,'#/shrine':882}; js/modules/books.js:1651 (full query), 1600-1603 (sort comparator recomputing worksOf per comparison)
findings.fix: Precompute per-author aggregates once per filter change (a map name→{works, vols, ch}) and sort on the cached values; cache the grouped rows between visits keyed on the vault's change counter.
findings.rootCause: Per-comparison recomputation in the sort (O(n log n × works)) plus an unbounded module read on every open.

findings.title: Small touch targets across Collection controls on iPad/iPhone (sort selects 30px, Mangaka letters 32px, Wishlist checkboxes 18px, Sync radios 13px)
findings.detail: With a coarse pointer: vault sort selects (Anime/Books/VN/Games/Shrine) are 173x30, Seasonal season select 104x30 and year field 96x31, Wishlist sort 132x30, Wishlist 'Simulate buying' checkboxes 18x18, Mangaka jump letters 32x32, Sync's autonomous-sync switch 34x20 and the XML import-mode radios 13x13. Invariant 69 asks for 44px on coarse pointers.
findings.evidence: DOM measurement at ipad/iphone (col-seed-ipad.json): SMALL ui.status-select vault.sort 173x30; mangaka.jump 32x32; plan.check 18x18; sync.auto-toggle 34x20; input radio 13x13
findings.fix: Apply the coarse-pointer min block size to `.k-select`/status-select and the year input in components.css; wrap the Wishlist checkboxes and Sync radios in 44px labels; give `.k-mk-key` 44px under (pointer:coarse).

findings.title: Vault toolbar wraps into three ragged rows on iPad portrait ('Find new' alone on a row, count alone above)
findings.detail: At 820px the Books/Anime/VN/Games controls block is 131px tall: the count ('738 series') sits on its own line, search/sort/filters/view/actions on a second, and the primary 'Find new' button alone on a third line at the left, under a separate 'Status & lists' row. The grid starts ~713px down the page. Ragged wrap with dead width on rows 1 and 3.
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-ipad.png; eval: vault.count @88,588; search @88,619 253x44 … Actions @721,619; 'Find new' @88,675 111x44; controls block 716x131
findings.fix: In the medview toolbar, put the count inside the search row (as on Mac) and let the primary button take the Actions slot (or fold Find new into Actions) under 860px, so the toolbar is one row plus the Status & lists button; or make 'Status & lists' share that row.
findings.rootCause: js/modules/medview.js toolbar() lays the count, the control row and the primary button out as separate flex items that wrap independently below the 1080 tier.

findings.title: Back (or any route change) leaves a vault editor open over the next page; Save then edits a title from another vault
findings.devices: Mac browser (Back key/gesture), iPad Safari tab (edge swipe)
findings.detail: Open an Anime title's editor, then press Back: the page behind changes to the previous route (Games) but the Anime editor drawer stays open on top of it. Navigating by hash with the editor open does the same — screenshots of #/books and #/vn still show 'Collection entry 686' (an anime) with Log episode. The modal no longer belongs to the page under it and its Save writes the anime row while the user is looking at Games/VN.
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-books-mac.png and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-vn-mac.png (anime editor over Books/VN); eval: open=1 hash=#/anime → history.back() → afterBack=1 hash=#/game h1=Games
findings.fix: On a routed navigation (router.js onPop/renderRoute, and KOS.show without _redraw) close every open KOS.ui.openDialog overlay first (cancel semantics, or ask if dirty), or have openDialog push a history entry so Back closes the dialog instead of the page.
findings.rootCause: js/core/router.js:283-297 onPop re-renders the view with KOS.show but nothing closes overlays opened by KOS.ui.openDialog (js/core/ui.js:155), which live outside #main.

findings.title: Books status rail counts the whole module while the grid shows one lens ('All 1107' beside '738 series')
findings.detail: On Books (Digital lens, the default) the rail reads All 1107 / In progress 221 / … while the toolbar count says 738 series and the grid holds 738. Switching to Physical Vault keeps the same rail numbers. Clicking a status therefore shows fewer titles than its count promises.
findings.evidence: eval on #/books: rail 'All 1107','In progress 221'…; vault.count '738 series'; lens 'Digital:true'
findings.fix: Pass the active lens predicate to filterRail (e.g. filterRail(module, onChange, {filter: lensFn})) and count only rows that pass it; recount when the lens changes.
findings.rootCause: js/modules/medview.js:1704-1712 reload() counts `KOS.mediadb.query({module})` — every row of the module — with no knowledge of the Books lens set in js/modules/books.js:1131.

findings.title: 'Hide amounts' does not hide money on the Wishlist, Mangaka or the Books shelf; currency is formatted three different ways
findings.detail: With Money's Hide amounts on (state.ui.moneyHidden = true) the Money page shows no figures, but the Wishlist still prints 'GBP 10.00', 'GBP 60.00 left of GBP 60.00', 'GBP 105.00', and Mangaka prints '£755 spent' on every author card. Invariant 5a says Hide amounts masks every amount on every surface. The same values are also formatted inconsistently: Money/Wishlist 'GBP 10.00' (ISO code + space, mono), Books/Mangaka a hard-coded '£755' / '£12.50' that ignores the user's currency setting.
findings.evidence: eval with moneyHidden=true: money page matches [] ; wishlist ['GBP 10.00','GBP 60.00',…]; mangaka ['£755 spent',…]; /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-wishlist-mac.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-mangaka-mac.png
findings.fix: Route every Collection amount through KOS.ui.amount (minor units, currency from KOS.money): wishlist.js money() (544-548), books.js:363 (Shelf value), books.js:1531 (author 'spent'), books.js:454 placeholder, and the Overview/analytics 'spent' figures.
findings.rootCause: js/modules/wishlist.js:544-548 and js/modules/books.js:363,1531 format money with string concatenation instead of the shared KOS.ui.amount primitive that owns masking and currency.

findings.title: AniList profile stat bands use a quarter of the card's width (auto-fill leaves empty tracks) and repeat the hero's figures on another scale
findings.detail: On #/aniprofile (connected; reproduced with a stubbed bundle) the Overview tab's 'Anime overview' and 'Manga overview' bands put four ~120px tiles at the left of a ~1210px card, leaving ~700px empty. The same figures are in the hero directly above on a different scale: hero 'mean 7.8' / '875d watched' vs band 'Mean score 78' / 'Days watched 875.0'. A zero (e.g. Volumes 0, Mean score 0) prints as a figure (invariant 77).
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/collection/b3-aniprofile-stub-mac.png; css/views/collection.css:859 (grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--pf-tile-min),1fr))); js/modules/aniprofile.js:252-259 (bands), 185-189 (hero figures /10)
findings.fix: Use repeat(auto-fit, …) (or a 4-column grid) so tiles share the width; pick one score scale (the hero's /10) and drop the band tiles the hero already shows (count, days) or replace them with figures the hero lacks (episodes, chapters, volumes); suppress zero-only tiles.
findings.rootCause: auto-fill keeps empty column tracks; hero and band were written independently

findings.title: Ordering a tied tier while the Shrine is filtered to one medium erases the hand-set rank of every other medium's titles in that tier
findings.detail: Shrine 'Set order' builds the dialog from the FILTERED favourites. On drop it stores only the visible titles' keys as the whole tier's order, so the other media's titles in the same score lose their rank and fall to the end in 'All media'. Reproduced: tier 10 ordered under All media (7 keys stored); switched to Anime (tier shows 3 titles), moved one title -> stored list for '10' is now 3 keys; the 4 non-anime titles' positions are gone. 'Reset to date enshrined' under a filter likewise wipes the whole tier for all media, with no confirm and no undo.
findings.evidence: eval repro on slot 17 (s1len 7 -> s2len 3); js/modules/shrine.js:809-813 (onDrop stores only list rows), 827-829 (reset, no confirm/undo), 972 (tiers from filtered favourites); js/core/media.js:580-596 setTierOrder replaces sh.order[k] whole
findings.fix: On drop, merge: take the stored order for the tier, replace the visible titles' slots in place with the new sequence, keep the hidden titles where they were (or only offer Set order under All media). Make Reset confirm (or offer Undo via toast) and reset only the visible titles when filtered.
findings.rootCause: tier order is one flat list per score, but the dialog edits a filtered subset and writes it back as the whole list

findings.title: Wishlist priority can only be set by HTML5 mouse drag: no keyboard path, no grip in Want to buy, unreliable on iPad touch (bypasses KOS.ui.reorder)
findings.detail: The Wishlist's 'Priority order' is a hand-ranked list ('Drag a row to set its priority'), but it is implemented with native draggable rows (dragstart/dragover/dragend) instead of the shared KOS.ui.reorder (⠿ handle, Space/↑↓, announced) that invariant 89a requires for every hand-ranked list. In the Want to buy tab the row's lead is the simulate checkbox, so there is no visible handle at all; the item editor has no priority field. Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot reorder; on iPad (touch, installed app) native HTML drag needs a long-press and fights scrolling.
findings.evidence: js/modules/wishlist.js:892-903 (draggable + hint text), 997-1002 (checkbox lead / aria-hidden grip), 1124-1140 (enableDrag HTML5); editor fields 700-727 have no priority
findings.fix: Use KOS.ui.reorder on the list with a ⠿ grip button per row (beside the checkbox in Want to buy), committing through reorder(status, ids).
findings.rootCause: wishlist predates the shared reorder primitive

findings.title: Mark purchased dialog: the Paid amount field is 57px wide and clips the price ('£ l0.00'); the date is cut to '06/11/20'
findings.detail: Opening 'Purchased' on a Want to buy row (Mac 1470) shows the Paid field with its 22px mono amount clipped: the input is 57px wide for 64px of '10.00', so the leading digit is cut; a three-digit price loses more. The date input is 106px and shows '06/11/20'. The two fields share one half of a two-column .k-pl-form while the other half holds two short guidance lines, leaving the inputs starved.
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/collection/b3-wishlist-buy-dialog-mac.png; eval: amount input w 57 / scrollWidth 64, date w 106; css/views/collection.css:756 (.k-pl-form 2 cols), 770 (.k-pl-two); js/modules/wishlist.js:1100-1103
findings.fix: Give the purchase dialog a single-column body (fields row full width, guidance under it) or span .k-pl-two across both columns; set a min-width on the amount field from its digits.
findings.rootCause: dialog body reuses the editor's two-column grid

findings.title: After Mark purchased, the Money confirmation and its 'View in Transactions' action are overwritten at once by the Collection handoff toast
findings.detail: Confirming a purchase toasts 'Added to Money · Collection › Games · £10.00' with a 'View in Transactions' button, then afterPurchase's handoff callback immediately toasts 'Added to Collection as planned.' into the same single #toast element, replacing the text and the action. Reproduced: after the click #toast reads only 'Added to Collection as planned.' The user never sees what was added to Money or gets the link; there is also no Undo for a purchase that wrote to Money and the Collection.
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17 after plan.buy-go: toast 'Added to Collection as planned.'; js/modules/wishlist.js:1095-1098 then 1109-1120; js/core/ui.js:72-81 (toast replaces textContent, no queue)
findings.fix: Compose one toast after the handoff ('Bought: £10 to Money · added to Games as planned') carrying both 'Undo' (setStatus back, which unarchives) and 'View in Transactions'; or give KOS.ui.toast a short queue.
findings.rootCause: two sequential toasts on a single-slot toast primitive

findings.title: A filter that matches nothing offers 'Bulk add' and 'Add one game' but no 'Clear filters'
findings.detail: Games: rail 'Completed' + Filters › Completion 'Platinum / 100%' gives '0 games (filtered)' and the empty card 'Nothing matches this filter.' with the two ADD buttons that belong to an empty vault. The way back (Clear filters, or clearing the status rail) lives in the Filters menu and the rail; the empty state itself is a dead end that pushes creation. The same pattern is in the other vaults' filtered empty states.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-game-filtered-empty-mac.png; eval: count '0 games (filtered)', Filters button 'Filters 1'; js/modules/games.js:739-749 (same buttons for filtered and empty)
findings.fix: When `filtered` is true render 'Clear filters' (calling every facet.clear(), the rail's All and the search reset) as the primary action, and keep Add as secondary.
findings.rootCause: emptyState called with the empty-vault actions regardless of the filtered flag.

findings.title: '+1' on a card deep in the grid re-sorts it to the top under the default 'recently updated' sort, so it vanishes from under the pointer
findings.detail: Anime vault, default sort 'Sort: recently updated', 240 cards loaded and scrolled ~10,600 px: pressing +1 on a card re-renders the grid and the card moves to position 1 (its top goes from on-screen to -9,892 px); the user sees the card they just logged disappear and a different card under the finger, with only the Governor toast as feedback. Logging several episodes in a row means hunting for the title again each time. Same in Books (+1 ch) and Games (+1 hr).
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17: n0 240 / n1 240 cards, scrollTop 10667 unchanged, bumped card top 0 -> -9891.8, first titles after bump ['Collection entry 457','QA XML Show']; js/modules/anime.js:281 (onBump -> bumpProgress(e, rerender)); js/modules/medview.js:576-600 (bumpUnit saves and calls done -> full rerender)
findings.fix: After a bump update the card in place (re-render that card only, keep the list order until the next deliberate refresh/navigation), or pin the bumped card in place for the visit; announce the new count through KOS.a11y.announce.
findings.rootCause: bumpUnit re-queries and repaints the whole sorted grid; the sort key (updatedAt) is the field the bump changes.

findings.title: Deleting a vault entry has no undo and leaves its Wishlist purchase pointing at nothing ('⇄ Collection' still offered, then 'That collection entry no longer exists.')
findings.detail: Games › open 'Wishlist title 3' (created by Mark purchased) › Delete record › Delete: the toast says 'Deleted.' with no Undo, and the confirm does not mention that a Wishlist purchase links to it. The Wishlist's Purchased row keeps linkedEntryId 1881 and still shows the '⇄ Collection' button; pressing it only toasts 'That collection entry no longer exists.' — a dead button with no way to relink from there. All of a title's personal layer (notes, quotes, routes, physical volumes) is lost in one tap.
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17: confirm text 'Delete “Wishlist title 3” from the collection?', toast 'Deleted.', no toast action; state.wishlist.items[id 3].linkedEntryId 1881 after deletion; Purchased tab row text '… GBP 10.00 ⇄ Collection'; click -> toast 'That collection entry no longer exists.'; js/modules/medview.js (record section Delete), js/modules/wishlist.js ('That collection entry no longer exists.')
findings.fix: Offer Undo on the delete toast (re-put the row with its syncId and drop the tombstone), mention linked Wishlist items in the confirm, and on delete clear linkedEntryId (or render the row's link as 'Link to vault' when the entry is gone).
findings.rootCause: Vault delete knows nothing about the Wishlist's linkedEntryId; Wishlist renders the link from the stored id without checking it exists.

findings.title: iPad landscape (1180): the vault toolbar overflows leftwards over the title count; search squeezed to 112px ('Search bc')
findings.devices: iPad Air 11 landscape (1180x820); any width 1081-~1300 with the rail open
findings.detail: In every vault at 1180 px the toolbar's fixed controls (sort, Filters, layout, Actions, Find new/Add) plus the search's 7rem minimum are wider than the space beside the count. Because .k-mtoolbar is justify-content:flex-end with min-inline-size:0 and its children flex-shrink:0, the overflow spills to the LEFT and the search pill is painted over the count: '739 series' shows as '73', the search placeholder is cut to 'Search bc'.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-ipadl.png; eval at ipadl: count 448-507 vs search 461-573 (Books), 448-503 vs 461-573 (Anime), 448-504 vs 499-611 (Games), 448-534 vs 451-563 (VN)
findings.fix: Let the toolbar wrap (flex-wrap: wrap with the search taking a full row) or move the count onto its own line from the 1240 breakpoint; never use flex-end on a row that can overflow (use margin-inline-start:auto on the first item instead so overflow goes right and wraps).
findings.rootCause: css/views/collection.css:62-65 (flex-end + no-shrink children + min 7rem search); the wrap rule at 975 only starts at 860px.

findings.title: Find new (Anime/Books) without AniList connected lets you search and pick, then toasts a self-contradicting message: 'added locally only. Nothing was added'
findings.detail: Anime › Actions › Find new titles… searches AniList fine while signed out of AniList; choosing a status ('Plan to watch') then toasts 'AniList isn't connected — added locally only. Nothing was added — the vault mirrors your AniList list, so add it there or reconnect and retry.' The first sentence (from the shared VNDB/AniList connect check) says it was added, the second that it was not; nothing is added (invariant 92). The dialog never says up front that AniList must be connected, so the user does the whole flow before finding out.
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17: search 'Frieren' → 6 results; + Add → 'Plan to watch' → toast text as quoted, no new row; js/modules/mediasearch.js:93 ("added locally only" reason) concatenated with :139 ("Nothing was added…")
findings.fix: Give the AniList path its own reason ('AniList isn't connected.') and, better, show a 'Connect AniList to add titles' banner with a Sync & Import link in the Find new dialog when there is no token, disabling + Add.
findings.rootCause: Reason string written for the VN fallback (which does add locally) reused for the mirror path that refuses.

findings.title: No link out to the title's AniList/VNDB page, and nowhere to keep 'where I watch/read it' (QoL)
findings.detail: The editor shows 'Linked to AniList' and knows anilistId/malId/vndbId, but only Games has an outbound link ('View on Steam ↗', games.js:333). Anime/Books/VN have no 'Open on AniList/VNDB' and no personal 'Where I'm watching/reading' URL. Proposal for the watch link: a manual-layer field `links: [{label, url}]` (or a single `watchUrl`) added in mediadb.normalise (js/core/mediadb.js:542, sanitised to http(s) only, no index so no DB version bump — like physical.seriesTotal), preserved in merge() beside notes/tags (mediadb.js ~1062: `inc.links = old.links.length ? old.links : inc.links`), unioned in foldLocal (mediadb.js:934) and covered by materialJSON automatically; never pushed (invariant 13 payloads stay status/progress/score) and excluded from search (71). UI: an input on 'Your layer' with a 'Use clipboard' helper; a '▶ Watch' / '📖 Read' button beside '+1 ep' on the card hover row, the Spotlight hero and the editor header, opening in a new tab (rel=noopener). The provider page link (AniList/VNDB) can be derived from the ids and shown on the Record tab.
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-layer-mac.png, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-anime-editor-record-mac.png; grep: only js/modules/games.js:57,333 build an outbound title URL
findings.fix: Add the field to normalise/merge/foldLocal as above, a URL input in the shared editor's personal layer (KOS.mediaEditors), and a Watch/Read action in medview's card and hero.

findings.title: Favourite heart on vault cards is a generic 'Toggle favourite' with no visible label and an easy mis-tap
findings.detail: The heart button on every card is labelled 'Toggle favourite' (aria-pressed is set, good) but sits at the card's top-right where a tap meant to open the card toggles the favourite instantly with no toast/undo; a Shrine membership changes silently. Measured 34x34 (below 44 on touch).
findings.evidence: eval: card button aria-label 'Toggle favourite', aria-pressed 'false', 34x34; reproduced an accidental favourite by clicking the card's first button
findings.fix: Label as 'Favourite <title>' / 'Remove <title> from favourites', show a toast with Undo ('Added to the Shrine'), and give it 44px on coarse pointers.

findings.title: Spotlight says 'the last one is next' when every route/episode is already done
findings.detail: A VN in progress at 2/2 routes reads '2 routes in — the last one is next.' The branch fires when left === 0, i.e. nothing is left; 'the last one is next' describes left === 1. Same for an anime/book at its final episode/chapter count.
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-vn-mac.png (hero: '2 routes in — the last one is next.', chip 2 / 2 routes)
findings.fix: left === 0 → 'All N in — ready to mark it complete?' (offer a Complete action); left === 1 → 'the last one is next.'
findings.rootCause: js/modules/medview.js:1318

findings.title: Seasonal hero's art credit is unreadable on the painted scenery (Mac/iPad)
findings.detail: The credit 'art · kamo_nasus' is 11.5px muted grey (oklch 0.62) laid straight over bright foliage with no scrim, jammed against the Art menu button; at 1x it is close to invisible (on iPhone it sits on a darker patch and reads). The credit is a licensing obligation for hot-linked scenery (invariant 94).
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-seasonal-credit-zoom.png; eval: anime.season-credit 90x17 at 1269,300, colour oklch(0.62 0.012 265), next to Art button at 1369
findings.fix: Put the credit on the same dark pill as the Art button (or a local gradient scrim) and use --text-2 colour; keep 8px from the button.

findings.title: Seasonal controls on iPhone wrap into a ragged block (segmented control alone, right-aligned)
findings.detail: Season select and year field share row 1 (year field stops at 279 leaving 107px empty), the In progress/Everything switch sits alone right-aligned on row 2 with the left half empty, then Refresh airing/Anime vault on row 3. Three rows of controls and a dead half-row before the first title.
findings.evidence: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-fj-Developer-KurenaiOS---Web/083a292e-9158-4ad4-8d86-0c9b8abd3917/scratchpad/qa/shots/collection/seed-seasonal2-iphone.png
findings.fix: Under 560px make season+year one row at full width and the In progress/Everything switch full width (k-seg--grid) on the next, or move Refresh airing/Anime vault into the page's ⋯ menu.

findings.title: AniList profile action row wraps 'Avatar' onto its own line on iPhone
findings.detail: At 402px the row 'Refresh · Updated hh:mm:ss · Banner · Avatar' wraps so '✎ Avatar' sits alone on a second line at the left, under Refresh, ragged against 'Banner' at the right.
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/collection/b3-aniprofile-analytics-iphone.png; js/modules/aniprofile.js:133-140 (actionRow)
findings.fix: Group Banner and Avatar in one nowrap cluster (or a ⋯ menu) so they wrap together; or drop the 'Updated' time to the second line on phones.
findings.rootCause: flex-wrap row with independent children

findings.title: Want to buy rows label the purchase action 'Purchased' (reads as a status) while the hero and dialog say 'Mark purchased'
findings.detail: Each queue row's action button says 'Purchased', beside a 'Link to vault' text and a ✎; it reads as the row's state, not an action. The hero button and the dialog title/confirm say 'Mark purchased'.
findings.evidence: audit-evidence/2026-11/qa/shots/collection/b3-wishlist-dawn-mac.png (row right edge); js/modules/wishlist.js:1019-1022
findings.fix: Label it 'Mark purchased' (or 'Bought…') like the hero.
findings.rootCause: label drift

findings.title: Books card prints '0 ch' for a series read by the volume; long-form progress says '1 of 1 routes' / '1 hours'
findings.detail: Books overrides the shared progress grammar with its own progressText that falls back to the literal '0 ch' whenever the shared text is empty, so a light novel tracked by volumes reads '0 ch · 3 / 10 vol' (a zero-only supporting fact, invariant 77). Separately the shared long form always pluralises: a VN with one route cleared of one reads '1 of 1 routes', one hour reads '1 hours'.
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17: card text for fixture {books, progress {current 0, volumes 3, totalVolumes 10}} = 'QA Volume Novel | 0 ch · 3 / 10 vol'; KOS.media.progressText(vn 1/1 route,{long:true}) = '1 of 1 routes'; js/modules/books.js:195-201 (|| "0 ch"); js/core/media.js:489 (opts.long ignores the count); shots/collection/c4-books-volnovel-mac.png
findings.fix: Drop the '0 ch' fallback (show only the volume half when chapters are 0) and move the volume half into KOS.media.progressText so Books stops keeping a second grammar; in the long form pick singular when the count is 1.
findings.rootCause: Second progress formatter in books.js duplicating media.js (invariant 63 owner); LONG_UNIT has no singular.

findings.title: Editor header shows the browser's broken-image glyph when a cover URL fails (cards fall back to the kanji placeholder)
findings.detail: Open any vault entry whose coverUrl no longer loads (a hot-linked AniList/VNDB cover that moved, or a dead URL): the card shows the placeholder kanji because medview.cover() listens for 'error', but the editor's header art is a bare KOS.imageCrop.image with no error handler, so an empty grey tile with the broken-image icon in its corner is drawn.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-vn-editor-mac.png (top-left of the cover tile); eval: dialog img naturalWidth 0, display block; js/modules/medview.js:918-920 vs the card's handler at js/modules/medview.js:64-71
findings.fix: Reuse medview.cover() (or the same load/error settle) for the editor header so a failed cover falls back to the module kanji.
findings.rootCause: Two cover renderers; only the card one handles load errors.

findings.title: VN 'What counts as progress' offers no Percentage option, so the % mode the schema and editor support is unreachable for new titles
findings.detail: mediadb's VN_MODES include 'percent' and the editor builds a 'How far through (%)' field, but the radio list only offers Automatic / Routes / Chapters / Hours, and the % field is shown only when Automatic already resolves to percent (an old entry carrying progressPercent and nothing else). A new VN, or one that has any hours, can never be switched to a percentage, contradicting the comment above the control ('routes, chapters, or a percentage').
findings.evidence: js/modules/vn.js:261-273 (radio options, no percent), 317 (pctField.hidden unless src/mode is percent); js/core/mediadb.js:323 (VN_MODES includes percent); shots/collection/c4-vn-editor-mac.png (four options)
findings.fix: Add a 'Percentage through' radio (value percent) and show the % field whenever it is chosen; or retire percent from VN_MODES with a migration.
findings.rootCause: Radio list (11e) dropped the percent choice while the schema kept it.

findings.title: Score lives in a different place in each vault editor: Books puts an unlabelled '– / 10' box in the header, the others a 'Score /10' field that shows 0 when unscored
findings.detail: Books' editor carries the score as a small unlabelled number input beside Favourite in the header (placeholder '–'); Anime, VN and Games put 'Score /10' in the first tab's grid, and VN/Games print '0' for a title with no score while the card corner shows '★' (unscored). Same concept, three treatments, and an unscored title reads as scored 0.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-editor-phys-mac.png (header '– / 10'), c4-vn-editor-mac.png and c4-game-editor-mac.png ('Score /10' field = 0 / 2); eval: VN entry with no score -> editor score input value '0'; Books header input aria-label 'Score out of 10', data-ui vault.editor-score
findings.fix: Use one score control in the same place for every module (the header pattern with a visible label, or the field) and show an empty value/placeholder for unscored instead of 0.
findings.rootCause: Each module editor builds its own score control (books.js header vs vn.js/games.js/anime.js fields).

findings.title: Import and sync reports count every matched row as 'updated', even when nothing changed
findings.detail: Re-importing the same MAL XML (or any pull) reports 'N updated' for every matched row: bulkUpsert increments `updated` on every put, including the no-op merges whose updatedAt it deliberately keeps (invariant 36a). A user re-running an import or 'Sync now' sees e.g. '0 added, 1100 updated' and cannot tell whether anything moved.
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17: bulkUpsert of an unchanged XML row -> {added 0, updated 1}, updatedAt unchanged 1793940090274, journal 0; js/core/mediadb.js:1166-1170 (updated++ regardless of sameMaterial); js/modules/mediasync.js:55-59 (doneWording prints it)
findings.fix: Count `unchanged` separately when sameMaterial() holds and word the result '3 updated, 1,097 already up to date' (or skip the put entirely for an unchanged row).
findings.rootCause: Counter not tied to the sameMaterial branch.

findings.title: Autonomous sync card says 'On' and runs cycles with no provider connected, and prints the last cycle twice
findings.detail: On an account with neither AniList nor VNDB connected the Autonomous sync card shows the switch On, 'Pulls every 15 minutes and on reconnect', a status line 'Last cycle 06/11/2026, 04:40:22 — nothing to reconcile' AND a separate 'Last cycle 04:40' figure beside it (two lines on iPhone). Nothing is being synced, so the card should say so and point to Connect; the time should appear once. The AniList token placeholder is also cut off ('The token AniList showe') at Mac width.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-sync-mac.png, shots/collection/c4-sync-iphone.png; js/modules/mediasync.js:422 (status line) and 432 (k-sy-auto-last duplicate)
findings.fix: When no provider is connected render the card as 'Nothing to sync yet — connect AniList or VNDB' with the switch disabled; keep one 'Last cycle' (the right-hand figure) and drop it from the status sentence; shorten the placeholder to 'Access token'.
findings.rootCause: renderAuto() ignores connection state; two renderers of the same timestamp.

findings.title: XML-imported Anime rows can never be deleted without AniList, and a Completed show with no episode total still offers '+1 · Log episode 31'
findings.detail: A MAL/AniList XML import lands anime rows with syncSource 'import'. The Anime editor follows the AniList-mirror rule (invariant 92: no Delete), so with AniList not connected a wrongly imported row has no way out except a 'Replace' re-import. In the same editor, a Completed title whose total is unknown (AniList total 0) still shows the primary '+1 · Log episode 31' bump, because the cap only applies when max is known.
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17 after importing a 3-title XML fixture: editor buttons for 'QA XML & Done' = ['+1 · Log episode 31','♥ Favourite',…,'Cancel','Save'] (no Delete, Record tab read-only); js/modules/medview.js:943-947 (capped only with b.max); mirror rule js/modules/anime.js editorModal
findings.fix: Offer Delete for anime rows whose syncSource is not 'anilist' (they are outside the mirror); hide or demote the bump when status is Completed.
findings.rootCause: Mirror read-only rule keyed on module rather than on syncSource; bump ignores status.

findings.title: Bar charts clip the value label of the tallest bar (Score distribution '168', medium charts '222')
findings.detail: KOS.charts.barChart reserves only padT = 12 above the plot and draws each value label at y - 5, so the tallest bar's label starts above the SVG's top edge (bbox y -3.8) and the SVG clips it; the tallest bars' labels look cut and crowd the card header (Books '222' under 'Books 1108 titles'). Every barChart and smallMultiples user (Collection Analytics, Reports, Money) inherits it.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-matrix-analytics-mac.png (Score distribution '168' labels; Books small multiple); eval: getBBox of the '168' label y = -3.79, svg overflow hidden; js/core/charts.js:84 (padT 12), 122-124 (label at y - 5)
findings.fix: Raise padT to FONT + 8 when value labels are drawn (or compute the plot from max + label height) so the tallest label sits inside the viewBox.
findings.rootCause: Top padding does not account for the value label above a full-height bar.

findings.title: Wishlist 'Purchased' tab is still laid out as a buy queue: priority ranks #1–#8, 'AVAILABLE NOW' / 'PRE-ORDER · IN 30 DAYS', sorted by priority
findings.detail: Purchase history reuses the Want-to-buy row: every bought item keeps a Priority badge (#1…#8), the Release column still says 'AVAILABLE NOW' or 'PRE-ORDER · IN 45 DAYS' for things already bought, and the default sort is 'Priority order', while the purchase date is shrunk to a 'bought 2026-11' chip (month only). The questions a history answers (when, how much, in which vault) are de-emphasised; a wide empty gap sits between the Collection column and the ✎ button.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-wishlist-purchased-mac.png; js/modules/wishlist.js:1015 (bought chip = monthKey), row builder ~990-1025 shared across tabs
findings.fix: On the Purchased tab drop the priority column and release countdown, show the full purchase date and paid amount as the leading facts and sort by purchasedAt (newest first).
findings.rootCause: One row renderer for every tab.

findings.title: Renaming or deleting a custom list that came from AniList is undone by the next pull (and a rename leaves both names)
findings.detail: Manage custom lists offers Rename/Delete for every list, including Anime/Books lists that AniList owns. rewriteLists only rewrites local rows and the kv registry and pushes nothing (list membership is never pushed, invariant 13). On the next AniList pull, bulkUpsert treats every list name AniList passes as AniList-owned (mirrorOpts lists) and re-adds the original membership, while the renamed name is now 'only this app' and unions — so a rename yields two lists and a delete comes back. The dialog gives no hint that the list belongs to AniList.
findings.evidence: code read: js/core/media.js:434-456 (rewriteLists, local only), js/modules/medview.js:1755-1770 (Rename/Delete for every name), js/core/mediadb.js:1089-1093 (owned AniList list names re-applied from the pull, others unioned); not reproduced end-to-end (no AniList account in the harness)
findings.fix: Mark lists that AniList carries (the mirror's list names, kept per module) as read-only in Manage ('Rename it on AniList'), and only offer Rename/Delete for app-only lists.
findings.rootCause: Manage lists does not know which list names the AniList mirror owns.

findings.title: Quote → flashcard writes the card at once while the quote itself waits for the editor's Save; Cancel keeps a card for a quote that no longer exists
findings.detail: In any vault editor's Quote log, a newly logged quote lives only in the editor draft (comment: 'The draft's quotes change only when the editor saves'), but '⇢ flashcard' › '+ Add to Personal deck' calls KOS.srs.addCustom immediately. Pressing Cancel (or Back) discards the quote and keeps the card. The success toast also tells the user to go 'Due Today → Personal deck' instead of offering that route as a toast action.
findings.evidence: js/modules/medview.js:722-746 (addCustom on press), 789-793 (quote pushed to the draft e.quotes, saved only with the editor)
findings.fix: Either save the quote together with the card (put the row when the card is made), or queue the card until the editor saves; add a 'Open Personal deck' action on the toast.
findings.rootCause: Two write timings inside one editor.

findings.title: Books 'Owned vs read' bars have no visible track (track colour = box colour) and the two 'one scale' bars get different lengths
findings.detail: In the Physical vault tab the bar track and the k-bk-box behind it are the same colour (both oklch(0.93 0.01 80) in Dawn), so each bar reads as a floating stub with no scale; on iPhone the two bars are 111 px and 103 px long because the track sits in an auto grid column sized by the detail text, so '1 of 10' and '3 of 10' are not drawn on the same scale the code comment promises.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-editor-iphone.png; eval (Dawn): bar bg oklch(0.93 0.01 80) == .k-bk-compare.k-bk-box bg; bar widths iPhone [111,103], Mac [373,365]; js/modules/books.js:300-312
findings.fix: Give the k-bar track a token one step off the box (e.g. --s3/--line) inside .k-bk-box, and lay the rows out on a shared grid (label | 1fr bar | fixed-width detail) so both tracks are equal.
findings.rootCause: Box and track share the same surface token; the detail column is auto-sized per row.

findings.title: Vault editor's section tabs overflow on iPhone with no scroller affordance: 'Quote lo…' cut, 'Identity' off-screen
findings.detail: The editor's tab row (Reading state · Physical vault · Shelves & tags · Quote log · Identity for Books; VN has six) is a plain overflow-x:auto segmented control (scrollWidth 438 > 362). The last tab is clipped mid-word and nothing indicates more tabs; it is not a declared KOS.ui.scroller (invariant 50: horizontal overflow must be declared, with edge marks).
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-books-editor-iphone.png; eval iPhone: tablist .k-seg.k-medit-tabs scrollWidth 438 / clientWidth 362, overflow-x auto, no ui.scroller ancestor; tab right edges 104/208/316/393/458
findings.fix: Wrap the tab row in KOS.ui.scroller({keep, reveal}) so the active tab is revealed and the edge fade shows more, or shorten labels ('Shelf', 'Tags', 'Quotes') under 560px.
findings.rootCause: Editor tabs built as a bare k-seg instead of the shared scroller.

findings.title: Games copy contradicts itself about importing, and the Steam dialog signed out is a dead end with no button to sign in
findings.detail: The Games empty state says 'There's no import API a browser is allowed to use; this is the whole toolkit, honestly stated' and Bulk add's subtitle says 'no game API allows a browser import' — yet the same Actions menu offers 'Steam library… import what you own' and 'Find new titles… Search IGDB'. Signed out of cloud, 'Steam library…' opens a dialog whose only content is 'sign in from Archive → Account & Cloud Sync first' with no button to get there (only ✕).
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-steam-mac.png; js/modules/games.js:746 (empty-state copy), 479 (bulk add subtitle), 547-624 (Steam dialog)
findings.fix: Rewrite the empty state and bulk-add subtitle to name the three ways in (paste, IGDB search, Steam import); add an 'Open Account & Cloud Sync' primary button in the signed-out Steam dialog.
findings.rootCause: Copy predates the Steam/IGDB features.

findings.title: Dialogs opened from a vault's Actions menu return focus to the top of the page ('Skip to content') when closed
findings.detail: Games › Actions › The numbers (or Steam library…, Paste a list…) › Close: focus lands on the document's first element, 'Skip to content', instead of the Actions button, because the dialog records the menu item as its return target and the menu has been torn down by then. A keyboard or VoiceOver user is thrown to the top of a long page after every Actions dialog (invariant 49: focus restore).
findings.evidence: eval on slot 17 after closing 'Games — the numbers': document.activeElement text 'Skip to content', Actions aria-expanded 'false'; shots/collection/c4-numbers-mac.png
findings.fix: In KOS.ui.menu, when an item runs, hand openDialog the menu's trigger as the restore target (or restore to the trigger when the remembered element is disconnected).
findings.rootCause: openDialog restores to document.activeElement captured at open time — a menu item that is removed when the menu closes.

findings.title: 'Genres' charts list tags truncated to identical labels ('Protagonist with a Tra…' ×7)
findings.detail: The Games numbers dialog's 'Genres — where your taste actually lives' and the Overview Analytics 'Top genres' rank tags as well as genres and cut every label at ~24 characters, so several distinct long tags render as the same 'Protagonist with a Tra…' row distinguishable only by a hover title (none on iPad/iPhone touch). VNDB/AniList tags are routinely that long.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-numbers-mac.png (7 identical rows), shots/collection/c4-matrix-analytics-mac.png ('Protagonist with a Tra…'); js/core/charts.js:187 (row title on hover only; label cut by CSS ellipsis)
findings.fix: Wrap hbar labels to two lines (wrapLabel already exists) or widen the label column, add a <title> with the full name, and either rename the card 'Genres & tags' or keep genres only.
findings.rootCause: hbarChart truncates instead of wrapping; card mixes taxonomy fields.

findings.title: An empty vault still draws the full status rail of zeros and every toolbar control (sort, Filters, layout, search) around the empty state
findings.detail: Empty account, Games/Books/VN: the left rail lists All 0, In progress 0, Planned 0, On hold 0, Completed 0, Dropped 0 (zero-only supporting facts, invariant 77), and the toolbar offers '0 games', search, 'Sort: recently updated', Filters, grid/list and Actions over nothing. Books also shows 'Find new' twice (toolbar and empty state), and Find new cannot add anything until AniList is connected.
findings.evidence: shots/collection/c4-empty-game-mac.png, c4-empty-books-mac.png, c4-empty-vn-mac.png; js/modules/medview.js:1660-1675 (rail rows always drawn), games.js:739-749
findings.fix: While the vault has no rows hide the status counts (or the whole rail) and the sort/filter/layout controls, leaving the empty state's actions; in Books show one 'Sync & Import' primary and drop the duplicate Find new until AniList is connected.
findings.rootCause: Toolbar and rail are rendered before the count is known and never collapse for zero.

findings.title: 'Recently updated' sorts by the row's last write, not by your list activity: provider metadata changes (AniList tag ranks, covers, totals) and sync re-inserts restamp untouched titles, while titles you actually watched or read this week sink
findings.detail: User report 8 Nov, with screenshots of Anime and Manga. 10 of the top 15 anime under the default 'recently updated' sort had not been touched recently: Boku no Suki na Hito, Liar Game, Why Does Nobody Remember Me, Goodbye Lara, Spirit Circle, SPY x FAMILY S2/S3/Cour 2, Re:ZERO and Mushoku Tensei. Meanwhile the real recent activity on AniList (The Vermilion Mask ep 4, Summer Pockets, The Beginning After the End S2, Sasaki and Peeps; manga Hitozuma to JK ch 39-40, Hontou wa Watashi ga Iindesho?, Onna Tomodachi ch 28 and others) was not at the top. MECHANISM, from code: the sort is mediadb.js:785 `updated: b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt`. updatedAt is restamped on ANY material change of the row (sameMaterial, mediadb.js:429-441, compares every field except updatedAt, lastSyncedAt and reward), and that includes provider METADATA the pull refreshes on every cycle. One example is extra.aniTags (anilist.js topTags: AniList tags with rank >= 60, sorted by rank, top 8). Rank shifts as people vote, so the order or the set changes on popular titles. Cover/banner URLs, episode/chapter/volume totals, season, studio and duration do the same. So a popular or currently airing title rises to the top with no action from the user. AniList's own list-entry `updatedAt` (the user's last change to that entry) is not fetched (listQuery, anilist.js:226-238), so the app has no record of when the user last acted. One Piece and Mieruko-chan at the top are a one-off: the DI-27 hotfix gave them their own anime rows (inserted now). Mieruko-chan is presumably Aku no Kyouten's MAL-id twin.

findings.rootCause: One timestamp does two jobs: 'this row changed, push it to the cloud' (any field) and 'you did something with this title' (list state only). Provider metadata churn moves the first, and the sort reads it as the second.
findings.fix: Add an activity stamp distinct from updatedAt. Set it from AniList's list-entry `updatedAt` (add it to listQuery, mapped as e.g. `activityAt`), from VNDB's ulist `lastmod`, and from local list-state or personal edits (progress, status, score, notes; a user save). Sort 'recently updated' by it (fall back to updatedAt only when a row has none). Keep updatedAt for cloud dirtiness. Optionally stop restamping on metadata-only changes, or normalise aniTags order, to cut cloud churn too. Use the same activity definition as HR-31, so the vault, Reports and Home agree. Smoke: a pull that only reorders tags or changes a cover leaves the sort order unchanged; a progress step moves the title to the top.
